description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [100% Critical (25s)], [Awoken Monk], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Bequeathed Knowledge Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Awoken Monk
description.text: Monk abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Bequeathed Knowledge Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Bequeathed Knowledge after using two Monk abilities
